job_location: Vietnam (Connected Brewery Lighthouse Mexico / Poland / Vietnam)

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Embed best practices in modelling, performance optimisation, usability, and storytelling to elevate analytical maturity across the organisation.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize quality standards, documentation, testing/validation, and analytical rigor with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Taking a lead role in the development, testing, validation, and documentation of development of use case and features, ensuring they meet high standards of quality, accuracy, and user relevance.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect operational/manufacturing decision-making (Smart Brewery, Supply Chain) without financial-reporting or regulatory-audit language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product Leads; Business Analysts; SMEs; brewery teams; Data Engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an established 'D&A Product Organisation' with multiple named global squads, defined processes (Idea Portal, SNOW), and existing global-scale analytics products already deployed across Mexico/Poland/Vietnam, indicating a mature, specialized organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create advanced DAX measures, optimised Power Query transformations, and reusable modelling components that set the standard for product excellence.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (DAX measures, Power Query, semantic models, Power BI/Grafana) and concrete organizational processes (Idea Portal, SNOW, Definition of Ready) that show exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Embedded within one of our Supply Chain product squads (Packaging, Brewing, or Utilities)
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is embedded within a named product squad structure and serves product delivery, growth, and experimentation-style ways of working (Agile ceremonies, backlog items), a product orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: You shape end-to-end analytical designs, challenge assumptions, set quality standards, and provide guidance to colleagues across roles and regions.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets direction, standards, and mentors others across regions, strategic verbs throughout ('shape', 'set', 'lead', 'elevate', 'influence solution direction').
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Taking a lead role in the development, testing, validation, and documentation of development of use case and features, ensuring they meet high standards of quality, accuracy, and user relevance.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and validation are framed as an owned, leadership-level responsibility with explicit ownership language, not just a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Diagnose and resolve complex modelling, data quality, or logic challenges, collaborating with Data Engineers and BI Developers where necessary.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality and analytical integrity are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust framing dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Contribute to the refinement of global, reusable use cases aligned with the broader D&A roadmap.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-design language (shape end-to-end analytical designs, design and build dashboards) with refine/optimize language (refinement of use cases, performance optimisation) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Diagnose and resolve complex modelling, data quality, or logic challenges — a secondary quality/reliability concern, not a dominant compliance risk register.
